entries.title: INITIAL LAUNCH REPORT - Weird.Baby
entries.line:
Weird.Baby website is live
Alert — Incoming Email Server Load (contained)

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
body: Weird.Baby launched on schedule. No deviations; f(Ump) = 100%
Handoff is on track (T-6); Operations has hands-on-the-ball.

sections.label: DETAILED REPORT
body: o Not single sourced, so not as simple as "turn it off."
o Data transmissions went silent shortly after WB launch.

sections.label: ADDENDUM 01 - Event Log - Friday Launch(-2)
body: 15:00 - Weird.Baby email server Scheduled Early Auto Start
15:01 - Weird.Baby System BIST - No deviations; f(Ump) = 100%
The decision to resume was determined to be low risk, reversible, and a real world stress test.
The engineering team was more intrigued than concerned, and not involved in the determination.

sections.label: ADDENDUM 02 - Weekend Summary
body: Staff onsite to support Weird.Baby launch - Nothing to report.
The time was put to use reviewing the incoming data.
Pages of hexadecimal numbers; presumably needs to be compiled and assembled into something usable.

sections.label: ADDENDUM 03 - Event Log - Monday Day(1)
body: 00:00 - WB Go-Live went off without a hitch.
The remainder of the day was completely uneventful.
We decided to stand up /Robots as a page to track our progress for a few days. It is weird if nothing else. Maybe try to get a little crowdsourcing going on dealing with this, going forward.

entries.title: GENERAL STATUS UPDATE
entries.line:
Weird.Baby Integrity Management Plan remains on-track without anomalies.
Email Server Data Assault has ceased; no net impact.

body: All process controls are in good order.  Operations is turning the crank, keeping tings moving on cadence.
The adrenalin from the launch and the weekend has finally worn off; we are all running on fumes.  No time was spent on the mystery data stream, today.
